context: A breaking-news segment on a power-plant explosion
purpose: Report a disaster; teach 発電/爆発/電力/損害/デモ/受信/知事/表明

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 速報です。発電所で爆発がありました。
lines.en: Breaking — there was an explosion at a power plant.
lines.style: grave teacher delivering urgent news, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 電力供給に影響は出てるんですか？
lines.style: concerned student asking practically, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 周辺で大きな損害が出ているそうです。
lines.en: Major damage is reported in the surroundings.
lines.style: somber teen relaying info, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 住民は抗議デモを準備しているようです。
lines.en: Residents seem to be preparing protests.
lines.style: teacher noting public response, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 速報を受信して、すぐに動かないと。
lines.en: We have to receive updates and move quickly.
lines.style: student urging action, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 知事はもう声明を表明しました。
lines.en: The governor has already issued a statement.
lines.style: teen noting the official response, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政府も対応を急ぐべきです。
lines.en: The government should hurry to respond too.
lines.style: teacher calling for action, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
